text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-sentence paragraphs with repeated example structures","quality":"organization","description":"The essay shows more control over paragraphing and overall structure, with ideas grouped into sections rather than presented as one continuous run-on."},{"evidence":"“My uncle usually share…”, “He travels different countries…”, “I love when my uncle…”","quality":"sentence control","description":"The writing has more complete and readable sentence patterns, even though there are errors, so the meaning is easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“different countries have different culture,” “how this work gives me benefit”","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops its points with repeated explanations and examples, making its claims clearer and more sustained."},{"evidence":"“when ever”, “collage”, “advantages”, “wisdom”","quality":"word choice","description":"It uses a somewhat wider range of recognizable vocabulary to express ideas, rather than relying on very limited or broken word forms."},{"evidence":"“world i heard carefully”, “learning from other always helps you in your future”","quality":"meaning clarity","description":"The intended message is more understandable overall, with fewer severe distortions that block comprehension."}]}
